title: Rösti
description:
Rösti (Repackaged Öpen Source Threat Intelligence) parses public threat reports from hundreds of security vendors, researchers and CERTs and turns them into machine-readable IOCs, YARA rules and MITRE ATT&CK references. Every IOC carries a false-positive risk score based on about 30 allowlists.

This connector imports Rösti reports into OpenCTI as STIX reports containing:
- indicators and observables for IPs, CIDRs, domains, URLs, email addresses, file hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SSDEEP, SHA-224), file names and paths, mutexes, user agents and cryptocurrency wallets; the Rösti false-positive risk sets the score, Rösti tags become labels and the IDS flag sets detection,
- YARA rules as indicators,
- MITRE ATT&CK techniques, mitigations, groups, campaigns and software,
- CVEs as vulnerabilities.

The connector imports reports created or updated since its last run and resumes from a checkpoint after interruptions.
short_description: Import IOCs, YARA rules, MITRE ATT&CK references and CVEs extracted by Rösti from public threat reports.
